t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the gnomes come in fixed pairs of colours. the different coloured gnomes will take you to either the light or dark forest. the number of mushrooms in the forests keeps changing. keep track of which gnomes take you to which forest

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in pairs of different colours that don't change throughout the game, although their position will change. some gnomes take you to the dark forest and some take you to the light forest. the amount of mushroom each gnome finds will change so while it is helpful to learn how successful each gnome is don't become too fixed on their colour. the 1.5 seconds can pass quickly so don't overthink it, try to get into a good rhythm so you're not timed out
